limitations: These are dependency-free lifecycle reductions, not executions of the target repositories.
The OpenCode model preserves registry removal, replacement busy publication, and delayed stale idle publication; it does not model the Event effect implementation or HTTP transport.
The TanStack model preserves ordered shared transforms and intermediate persistence; it does not exercise storage adapters or artifact byte handling.
The Vercel model preserves assistant-message adoption before resumed identity; it does not exercise framework rendering or transport replay.
